_doc: The Avalanche Ram's surfaces (docs/kb/art/creatures/act2/avalanche_ram.md). Slots are the glTF material names; write_materials.py writes assets/creatures/avalanche_ram/materials/<slot>.tres on game/shaders/creature/creature.gdshader. fleece is the coat, the six chains of sodden locks, the mane and the bib, the head (M3-CRE-635: its face, the soft muzzle and the jaw in the coat's colour, darkened laterite only at the nose and lips by vertex colour), the woolly cap and ears (undyed sand_cloth gone grey to overcast_slate, the wet mats, the beard and the dripping lock ends soaked dark and glossy by wetness (M4-A2P-059, ADR 0015: no ice)) and the partings, whose emission mask glows spawn_wound (the weak points); hide is the darkened laterite legs (their wool above the knee by vertex colour), the nostrils and hooves and the faded lacquer_red herd-cord; eye is wet lacquer_black. Colours are palette.json swatches.
